query: Battery management system PCB assemblies tariff exposure

statements.text: Chinese PCBs and BMS | 25–30% | Electronics in smart battery packs

Tariffs on rigid and flex PCBs sourced from China typically range from 25% to 30%. This means higher costs for prototyping and production alike, complicating budgeting during early-stage design and putting pressure on already tight development cycles.
BMS electronics sourced from China carry 25 to 30 percent tariffs that can meaningfully affect smart battery pack pricing.
